insider_details.detail: Across all five HNMS stations, June, July and August average under about 1.5 rain days a month, while October brings rain back (5.5 days at Naxos, 6.5 at Rodos, 7.5 at Heraklion, 9.3 at Chania Souda, 11.4 at Kerkyra). Corfu turns wet earliest: Kerkyra averages 87.8 mm in September and 140.4 mm in October, so an October Corfu date needs a covered plan B.

Heat, not rain, is the peak-season constraint: Kerkyra averages a 31.5 C maximum in August and Chania Souda 30.7 C in July, and Smartraveller warns that heatwaves are frequent and wildfires run June to September. Hold ceremonies in the evening (Nana Princess suggests 18:30 to 20:00 in July and August) and keep guest excursions short and shaded.

The Cyclades are windy all year at the Naxos station (prevailing north wind every month, wind power rising to 13.3 to 13.9 from July to September), and Smartraveller says ferries can be delayed or cancelled in strong winds. Build a buffer day between island hops and the wedding, and plan exposed clifftop or beach set-ups with wind in mind. Naxos is the nearest official station, so label figures as Naxos, not Santorini, Mykonos or Paros.

Venue seasons are shorter than the weather window: Angsana Corfu's Vertigo Sky Bar runs only mid-May (ceremonies) or end of May (receptions) to end of September, while its Oribu Garden runs April to October. Minos Palace says eastern Crete is pleasant from April to November. Check each venue's own dates before choosing a shoulder-season month.

For a Greek Orthodox ceremony, the Archdiocese of Australia's closed dates rule out 1 to 15 August, 29 August, 14 September, 13 to 25 December, 5 January and Great Lent to Easter Sunday, which moves every year. Lock the church date before the venue.

Spring brings Saharan dust storms that reduce air quality and visibility, per Smartraveller, and April still averages 6.0 to 7.7 rain days at the HNMS stations. A late-April or early-May date suits couples who prefer milder temperatures (Rodos mean 16.8 C in April, 20.7 C in May) but should carry an indoor option.
